description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a task management screen. It handles displaying a list of tasks, refreshing data, adding new tasks via a dialog, toggling completion status, and deleting tasks. It interacts with a TaskService for data operations and maintains local UI state.

classes.name: TasksScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays and manages a list of tasks with features to add, toggle, and delete tasks.

classes.name: _TasksScreenState
classes.description: State class for TasksScreen that manages the task list, loading/error states, and contains methods for data operations and UI interactions.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches tasks from the service and updates the task list, handling loading state and errors.

methods.name: _addTaskDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input new task details and adds the task via the service.

methods.name: _toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completed state of a task and updates it via the service.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes a task via the service and updates the local list.
